final: WITH m AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ref, o.dealedge AS side FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault), g AS (SELECT ref, side, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM m GROUP BY ref, side), s AS (SELECT side, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g GROUP BY side) SELECT g.ref, g.side, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / s.total AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.side = g.side ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
